brand.platformNameZh: 想去就出发｜旅行收藏与路线规划
brand.subtitleZh: 把收藏的地方，变成真正走得通的旅程

xiaohongshu.requires: xiaohongshu.com 笔记完整链接及 xsec_token；短链仅保留，需补完整链接或截图

ctrip.requires: 链接来源同时提供地点名；用目的地与链接内地点 ID 消歧

wechat_official.requires: 可公开打开的公众号文章 URL

mafengwo.requires: 保留原链接；安全检测时补截图、保存网页或粘贴文字

featuresZh: 截图、链接、视频和文字收纳
按目的地分库与地点卡
想去护照、基础片区分组、修改与导出

preTripReview.descriptionZh: 按出发时间复核已收藏地点的公开状态，并交付可见变更；不包含完整逐日行程。
preTripReview.descriptionEn: Recheck public place information before departure and show what changed. A full day-by-day itinerary is not included.

manualItineraryBeta.descriptionZh: 一个城市、1–3 天、2–10 个地点，含一次范围内修改。
manualItineraryBeta.descriptionEn: One city, 1–3 days and 2–10 places, with one in-scope revision.
exclusionsEn: No booking on the customer's behalf

copy.onboardingZh: Kornvia 想去就出发已准备好。把本轮旅行截图、公开链接、视频或文字发给我，我会先收进按目的地整理的想去库，不会擅自生成攻略。小红书完整笔记链接、携程地点链接和公开公众号文章会按平台规则读取；马蜂窝遇安全检测时会保留原链接，并请你补截图、保存网页或文字。多地点文章不会冒充一个地点，需要指定地点名或拆分收纳。需要整理时，说“生成曼谷想去护照”。免费版包含收纳、分库、地点卡、护照、基础片区分组、修改和导出；出发前按需复核为 ¥39.9；一个城市、1–3 天、2–10 个地点的人工逐日行程内测为 ¥199，含一次范围内修改，不代订、不持续监控。
copy.onboardingEn: Kornvia Want to Go is ready. Send travel screenshots, public links, videos or text from this turn and I will save them by destination in your want-to-go library without creating a guide unless asked. Full Xiaohongshu note URLs, Ctrip place URLs and public WeChat Official Account articles use verified platform adapters. If Mafengwo presents a security check, the submitted URL is retained and a screenshot, saved page or pasted text is requested. Multi-place articles are not presented as one place; name the target place or split the source. The free tier includes capture, destination libraries, place cards, passport, basic area grouping, edits and export. Pre-trip review is ¥39.9. The ¥199 manual itinerary beta covers one city, 1–3 days and 2–10 places with one in-scope revision; it does not include booking or continuous monitoring.
copy.savedNextStepZh: 想把收藏整理成网页攻略，可以说“生成{destination}想去护照”。
copy.savedNextStepEn: Say “Create my {destination} Go passport” when you want a web guide.
copy.passportReadyZh: 想去护照已生成。免费版可继续修改、排序、撤销和导出；临近出发时可提交 ¥39.9 出发前复核。需要人工逐日安排时，¥199 内测仅覆盖一个城市、1–3 天、2–10 个地点，含一次范围内修改，不代订、不持续监控。
copy.passportReadyEn: Your Go passport is ready. The free tier remains editable, sortable, undoable and exportable. A pre-trip review is ¥39.9. The ¥199 manual itinerary beta is limited to one city, 1–3 days and 2–10 places with one in-scope revision; no booking or continuous monitoring is included.
